units.source_text: 女人卻不懂什麼叫「適可而止」，她們總是沒完沒了地要求我搞笑，

en.t: Women, however, did not understand what it meant to stop at a reasonable point, and they kept endlessly demanding that I make them laugh,

units.source_text: 為了滿足她們一而再再而三的「再來一個」，我累得筋疲力盡。

en.t: In trying to satisfy their repeated cries of one more, I wore myself out completely.

units.source_text: 女人似乎比男人更具備享受笑的特質。

en.t: Women seem to possess, more than men, a special capacity for enjoying laughter.

units.source_text: 我在中學寄宿的親戚家裡，兩位表姐一有空便會來到我二樓的房間，

en.t: At the relatives house where I boarded during middle school, my two older girl cousins would come to my room on the second floor whenever they had free time,

units.source_text: 每次都嚇得我差點跳起來，一個勁地感到緊張害怕。

en.t: and each time I was so startled I almost jumped, feeling nothing but tension and fear.

units.source_text: 我微笑著合上書本說，「今天啊，學校裡有位叫棍棒的地理老師……」

en.t: I smiled, closed my book, and said, Today at school there was a geography teacher called Club...

units.source_text: 從我的口中蹦出的都是言不由衷的笑話。

en.t: What sprang from my mouth was always jokes I did not mean at all.

units.source_text: 「小葉，你戴上眼鏡讓我們看看。」

en.t: Yozo, put on your glasses and let us see.
